Slice 3 widens the fixture to the full fleet: CLI banners (start auto-migrates loudly, quiet second, zero-move quiet), the MCP door's honest legacy-up-to-date truth, dual-mode read fallback, and the adversarial edges (self-nest prevention, stack rewrite, multibrain-files-win, walker symlink wall, failed-verify withholds the marker, the CLI's exit-1 could-not-verify truth, and the health tripwire's warn-then-silent).
